mechanics.claim: Ornn deals magic damage every 0.15 seconds to enemies hit in the cone for the duration of the march.
mechanics.quote: he belches fire over a cone in front of him, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.15}} seconds to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: The final tick of damage reaches slightly farther and additionally applies Brittle for 3 seconds.
mechanics.quote: The final gout of flame can reach slightly farther and will apply {{tip|Brittle}} for 3 seconds.

mechanics.claim: Each tick has a minimum damage threshold below which it cannot fall, and this is also the flat damage dealt to minions.
mechanics.quote: ''Bellows Breath'' has a minimum damage threshold, which is also the damage dealt to {{tip|minion|minions}}, and is capped against {{tip|monsters}}.

mechanics.claim: Damage against monsters is capped per tick.
mechanics.quote: ''Bellows Breath'' has a minimum damage threshold, which is also the damage dealt to {{tip|minion|minions}}, and is capped against {{tip|monsters}}.

mechanics.claim: Ornn is unable to act and immune to displacement for the full duration of the march.
mechanics.quote: Ornn {{tip|lunge|marches}} forward in the target direction over {{fd|0.75}} seconds, gaining {{tip|displacement immunity}} and becoming {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for the duration.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield will negate only the final instance of damage and prevents Brittle from being applied, while earlier ticks still land.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will negate the final instance of damage and prevents {{tip|Brittle}} from being applied.
